title: cq agy broker reply
description: reply.json, written by the agy turn in its exchange job folder: UTF-8 (one UTF-8 BOM is allowed; UTF-16 and NUL bytes are refused), at most 65536 bytes, no other fields. The watcher reads it only after every process of the turn has stopped, and only if it is a regular file with one link that no process holds open for writing.

text.description: Not only white space; at most request.json "reply_max_bytes" UTF-8 bytes.
